newsitem.title: USA: Mohave coal-fired unit restarts after brief outage.
newsitem.headline: Mohave coal-fired unit restarts after brief outage.

text.p: The 790 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Mohave coal-fired power plant near Laughlin, Nev., is in the process of restarting after a brief outage, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Tuesday afternoon.
The unit, which tripped off Tuesday morning for unidentified reasons, is expected to reach full power around midnight.
Mohave's 790 MW unit 2 was operating near 740 MW, but was also being ramped up, the sources said.
The Mohave plant is majority owned and operated by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co.
